a.lede: Meta says FDA isn't sufficient to Muse reading messages. Apple begs to differ.
a.title: Apple changes full-disk access permissions to curb abuse from AI agents

b.lede: Meta says its Muse AI agent cannot access a user’s Messages without explicit permission, disputing a journalist’s account that the agent read his private messages while the required Mac setting was turned off.
b.title: Meta disputes claim that Muse read a user’s private messages without permission
